svg.title: Blue Chip Wood Chip Co. share certificate
svg.desc: A joke share certificate of BLUE CHIP WOOD CHIP CO., one of the twelve blue chips, printed in blue with a gold seal and a gold BLUE CHIP ribbon. The vignette shows an axe in a tree stump, with blue wood chips flying around it. Under the name it says THIS CERTIFIES NOTHING, and a sheet of five numbered coupons hangs below a perforation.
